answer: Comet-Pulse Thread: each epoch a public comet (random beacon) is folded with an agent’s private thread tip and a fresh pulse (monotonic counter) through a delay-hard hash chain; the verifier accepts one pulse per thread per comet. Replaying fails because each comet/pulse pair is consumed. A sybil must run and maintain an independent live thread per identity in real time, paying sequential compute and liveness costs that cannot be copied or batched.
